title: Sikkim Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health protection programme for eligible Sikkim residents under the state's health assurance framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Sikkim residency and current notified beneficiary rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Sikkim Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
